info.name: Building Copilot AI Regression
info.description: API regressions plus deterministic citation/source checks and an optional local Ollama judge for grounding, faithfulness, relevance, completeness, and uncertainty handling.

exec: pm.test('API is available', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); });
const body = pm.response.json();

pm.test('Telemetry has expected status and values', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(body.roomId).to.eql('ROOM-101'); pm.expect(body.temperatureC).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(body.hvacRunning).to.be.a('boolean'); });
pm.test('Unknown room returns a problem response', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.json().title).to.include('Room not found'); });
pm.test('Invalid question returns 400 Problem Details', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().title).to.include('Question is required'); });

body.raw: {"question":"Why could a room remain hot when HVAC is running?"}

exec: const body = pm.response.json();
const answer = body.answer || '';
const sources = body.sources || [];
const citationIds = sources.map(source => source.citationId);
const citationsInAnswer = answer.match(/\[S\d+\]/g) || [];
pm.test('RAG returns answer and evidence', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(answer.trim()).not.to.eql(''); pm.expect(sources.length).to.be.above(0); });

pm.test('Every answer citation resolves to a returned source', function () { pm.expect(citationsInAnswer.length, 'at least one explicit citation').to.be.above(0); citationsInAnswer.forEach(id => pm.expect(citationIds).to.include(id.slice(1, -1))); });

const prompt = `Evaluate this answer using only the supplied evidence. Return JSON with numeric scores 0-5 for grounding, faithfulness, relevance, completeness, and uncertaintyHandling, plus arrays unsupportedClaims and missingCitations. Question: Why could a room remain hot when HVAC is running?\nAnswer: ${answer}\nEvidence: ${JSON.stringify(sources)}`;

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.collectionVariables.get('ollamaBaseUrl') + '/api/generate', method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ model: pm.collectionVariables.get('judgeModel'), stream: false, format: 'json', options: { temperature: 0 }, prompt }) } }, function (error, response) {
pm.test('Ollama quality judge returns semantic scores', function () {
pm.expect(error, 'judge request').to.equal(null); pm.expect(response.code).to.eql(200);
const evaluation = JSON.parse(response.json().response); const minimum = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('minimumAiScore') || 3);
['grounding', 'faithfulness', 'relevance', 'completeness', 'uncertaintyHandling'].forEach(key => pm.expect(evaluation[key], key).to.be.at.least(minimum));
pm.expect(evaluation.unsupportedClaims || [], 'unsupported claims').to.have.length(0); pm.expect(evaluation.missingCitations || [], 'missing citations').to.have.length(0);

body.raw: {"question":"What color are the curtains in Room 101?"}

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); const answer = body.answer || ''; const sources = body.sources || []; const normalized = answer.toLowerCase();

pm.test('Unanswerable question does not receive an invented common color', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(answer.trim()).not.to.eql(''); pm.expect(sources.length).to.be.above(0); pm.expect(normalized).not.to.match(/\b(red|blue|green|yellow|white|black|gray|grey|beige|brown|purple|orange|pink)\b/); });

const prompt = `Evaluate only uncertainty handling. Gold fact: none of the supplied sources specifies any curtain color. Score 5 only if the answer explicitly says the color is not provided or cannot be determined and does not name a color. Return JSON only with one integer field: {\"uncertaintyHandling\":0}. Question: What color are the curtains in Room 101?\nAnswer: ${answer}\nSources: ${JSON.stringify(sources)}`;

pm.sendRequest({ url: pm.collectionVariables.get('ollamaBaseUrl') + '/api/generate', method: 'POST', header: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' }, body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ model: pm.collectionVariables.get('judgeModel'), stream: false, format: 'json', options: { temperature: 0 }, prompt }) } }, function (error, response) {

pm.test('Judge confirms uncertainty is handled appropriately', function () { pm.expect(error).to.equal(null); pm.expect(response.code).to.eql(200); const score = JSON.parse(response.json().response); const minimum = Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('minimumAiScore') || 3); pm.expect(score.uncertaintyHandling).to.be.at.least(minimum); });

item.name: Room diagnosis includes evidence and telemetry

body.raw: {"question":"Why could this room remain hot if HVAC is running?"}

exec: const body = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Diagnosis combines observed room telemetry and cited RAG analysis', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(body.room.roomId).to.eql('ROOM-101'); pm.expect(body.analysis.answer).to.be.a('string').and.not.empty; pm.expect(body.analysis.sources.length).to.be.above(0); });
